supporting_observations.claim: At 13:47:35 UTC, Zeek recorded a TCP flow from FILE-BLU-01 (10.54.20.20) to the proxy (10.54.20.30:8080) with 640,000,395 bytes sent by the source and 39,204 bytes received.
A second, much smaller flow from FILE-BLU-01 to the proxy was recorded shortly before the large flow.

The available network record establishes a large transfer to the explicit proxy, but does not identify the ultimate destination or the process responsible. The transfer size alone does not distinguish an approved backup upload from unauthorized activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied collection-status information reports a FILE-BLU-01 winsec and Sysmon collection outage from 13:25 to 14:20 UTC, covering the alerted transfer.
The supplied collection-status information reports a PROXY-BLU-01 proxy-log outage from 13:25 to 14:20 UTC, covering the alerted transfer.
Zeek connection telemetry is available for the large flow, but the cited record contains no process attribution, requested URL, or ultimate destination.
claims_not_established: Whether the transfer was generated by the approved Cloudkeep backup agent or another process.
Whether the ultimate destination was cloudkeep-backup.com or an unapproved service.
What data was transferred, whether it was sensitive, and whether the transfer was authorized.
Whether the transfer completed successfully at the ultimate destination.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain proxy transaction logs for the transfer window, including the requested host, URL, and byte counts.
Obtain FILE-BLU-01 endpoint process and application logs for the transfer window to identify the process responsible.
Check Cloudkeep agent logs and offsite backup service records for a matching upload, job, destination, and time.
If available, review network or proxy records that establish the ultimate destination and whether the transfer was completed.
unrelated_findings: Ruth Moss launched mstsc.exe to FILE-BLU-01 from WS-RMOSS-01 and connected over RDP. This appears outside the stated remote-administration practice, but it occurred after the alerted transfer and does not establish its cause or destination; handle as a separate finding.
